coreBelief: Eaton's electrical platform — anchored by a $14.5B+ Electrical Americas backlog, 41% rolling order growth, and a Mobility separation closing in early 2027 — compounds to $500+ over 3 years as datacenter-driven organic revenue sustains above 11% and segment margins recover above 24.5% on maturing capacity investments.

bullets.text: **Electrical Americas backlog of $14.5B was up 44% at end of Q1 2026**, with rolling 12-month organic orders up 42% versus negative 4% a year prior — an inflection of rare magnitude in an industrial.

**Data center revenue grew approximately 65% year over year in Q2**, well ahead of the segment's headline 18% organic, confirming that the datacenter mix-shift is accelerating gross margin structurally.

**Full-year 2026 organic growth guidance was raised to 11%–13%** with adjusted EPS of $13.40–$13.60 — guidance has been raised twice in 2026, a pattern that historically precedes sustained earnings upgrade cycles.

**Mobility divestiture in early 2027** strips the lowest-margin, most cyclical segment and forces a P/E re-rating toward pure-play electrical comps — the structural case for multiple expansion above the current 37.2× P/E [STRUCTURED:PE].

**Management disclosed at the Barclays Industrial Select Conference that U.S. data center capacity under construction has grown to 32 GW, with total planned backlog of 165–228 GW through 2030** — characterized as 12 years of build at 2025 installation rates, de-risking the secular demand assumption.

**Segment margin compression is real:** Q2 total segment margins of 23.1% are down 80 basis points from Q2 2025, and the Q1 print of 22.7% was down 120 basis points year over year — scaling costs are eating organic growth, and two consecutive margin misses would invalidate the thesis.
**No share repurchases in 2026** due to the Boyd Thermal acquisition, removing a meaningful EPS support lever at the same time as acquisition-related charges weigh on GAAP earnings.

**Hyperscaler capex concentration risk:** data center buildout depends on continued spending by Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Meta — any significant pullback in their plans would ripple directly into Eaton's order book.

**Trend Template at 4/8 and relative strength versus SPY negative across all measured windows** [STRUCTURED:trendTemplate, relativeStrength]: the stock is a sector-level laggard on a 6-month look, meaning institutional momentum buyers are not yet re-accumulating even as fundamentals improve.

**UBS (prior downgrade)** flagged that Eaton's earnings upgrade potential over the near term appeared limited, with margin pressures from capacity expansion making the stock sensitive to estimate revisions — the earnings report on November 3 is the resolution test.

keyAssumptions: Electrical Americas segment operating margins hold above 24.5% on a full-year 2026 basis, confirming that the Q1 2026 margin dip was a capacity-scaling trough, not a structural break.
Electrical Americas rolling 12-month order growth stays positive through Q4 2026, sustaining the book-to-bill ratio above 1.0 as backlog converts to revenue.
The Mobility / Dana Reverse Morris Trust transaction closes by Q1 2027 as guided, enabling a pure-play electrical and aerospace multiple re-rating.
invalidationConds: Two consecutive quarters of Electrical Americas operating margin below 24% — signals the scaling cost absorption is structural, not transitory.
Full-year organic growth guidance cut below 8% — would indicate hyperscaler capex is decelerating faster than backlog coverage suggests.
Mobility / Dana transaction collapses or is delayed beyond mid-2027, keeping the conglomerate discount in place and removing the re-rating catalyst.
CFO departure or a second officer exit within 90 days of the October 5 8-K filing — would undermine capital allocation continuity.

setup.name: Compounder accumulation
setup.time: A 60-day business checkpoint (is what we said would happen starting to happen?) — a review, never a time stop.
lines: Entry: Whichever comes first: a base breakout, a reclaim of the 50-day, or a pullback that holds the 50-day. A stock at new highs on a working thesis is working, not extended; with no pullback in 30 days of uptrend, take the breakout. When one is already true, set the entry at the current price. Confirm a buy by: Thesis intact; volume matters less than for a trade
Stop: Thesis invalidation named in advance (guidance cut twice, margin break, capital-allocation failure). A close below the 200-day and a 15% give-back are reviews.
Target: A 3–5 year valuation case; trims only at valuation extremes.
Time: A 60-day business checkpoint (is what we said would happen starting to happen?) — a review, never a time stop.
Failure looks like: The named invalidation happens; Guidance cut; Margin break
